messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: A client on a Mac says the portal sends them back to the login page right after they sign in.

messages.name: Maya (Support)
messages.body: That's BUG-2200-01, a Safari login loop caused by a cookie SameSite setting. A fix is already rolling out in 2.2.0. Ask the client to clear cookies for the portal and sign in again.

messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: That's not great, but we'll use the workaround.
